title: When review costs more than it saves
statement: How low a pass rate can fall before reviewing generated items costs more time than it saves; one framing guesses below 60%, and nothing has measured it.
detail: The AP question work's context document sets out quality bands and says that below 60% reviewing would take more time than the automation saves (`icloud-work/ML learnings/what_is_ap_and_why_it_matters.md`). The bands are framing: no review time was measured anywhere in the folder.

evidence.quote: would spend more time reviewing than they'd save from automation.
